stands_for: cv-generic/2026-08-30_cv_EN.pdf read whole, in one call: the profile and the questions it leaves open, which is what the reading answers now that there is no classification, no extraction per document and no merge (ID157, ID158). Its 31 items were read from the file itself with pdftotext — eight posts from HEIG-VD back to AgenceWeb, eight projects, eight skill groups and their entries, three diplomas, the CHI 2024 paper and the languages — each citing the one part it came from. The three questions are what a single document cannot answer: a language with no post naming where it was written, and two projects with no organisation beside them. No conflict candidate, and there cannot be one: a conflict is two parts disagreeing, and there is one.
